objective: Turn freshness from a UI feature into an auditable operating advantage: volatile facts must be dated, stale operator claims must lose NOW priority, and source freshness must never be confused with first-party confirmation.

classes.rule: Only same-day operator evidence may be presented as today confirmed.
After 30 days operator hours lose NOW priority and fall back to the verified base path.
Use as an internal source-review SLA; this does not convert source research into operator confirmation.
Use as an internal recheck SLA for launch-critical identity/location provenance.
Respect each fact's explicit stale_after; do not replace feature-level freshness with a global age.
Lifecycle validity and source timestamps govern; generic age alone must not keep expired content live.

derivedReadout.interpretation: Editorial/source recency is strong where evidence exists, but first-party live freshness is currently zero. CAT-02 therefore targets confirmation coverage and operating discipline, not a cosmetic freshness badge.

cat02ImplementationReadyWhen: all volatile public claims carry an auditable timestamp or explicit unknown state
stale operator hours never receive operator NOW priority
same-day operator evidence is the only basis for a today-confirmed claim
freshness coverage is reported separately for source research and operator confirmation
the production freshness audit is reproducible and SELECT-only
cp2FreshnessTrustAdvantageMayBePromotedO: a representative real-business cohort has recurring first-party confirmations rather than one-off setup evidence
measured operator-confirmed facts remain within the frozen SLA across an observation period
zero known stale operator facts receive NOW priority in audited production behavior
consumer-facing provenance/freshness language matches the actual evidence level
a dated competitor benchmark exists for the compared mechanism; absence of competitor data cannot be treated as superiority

nextExecution.action: Create a recurring SELECT-only freshness audit across core, location, hours, menu, accessibility and operator-confirmed services.
Use existing merchant-truth-freshness 2.50 as the canonical hours runtime; do not create a second freshness engine.
Increase first-party operator confirmation coverage only after the existing contact/terms/release gates permit outreach and operator activation.
Extend field-specific first-party confirmation beyond weekly hours only through the existing ACQ-05 rights/confirmation architecture.
Refresh the external competitive benchmark before any comparative freshness-superiority claim.
